Native American and Indigenous Peoples Cohort (Ohio State University)

Ohio State’s 2024 list of student organizations names the Native American and Indigenous Peoples Cohort. University records document the cohort’s work to build community among Native and Indigenous students in Columbus.

Selected reading

01

Building community on campus

Ohio State’s fellowship page describes how Arvcúken Noquisi’s 2021–22 project documented the cohort’s efforts to strengthen community among Indigenous students.

Read the sources [3] The Ohio State University Global Arts and Humanities Discovery Theme

The welcome gathering

The university’s 2023 event notice lists the cohort as a co-host of a Native American and Indigenous welcome gathering held at the Ohio Union in Columbus.
